verdict.rationale: Windmill's AI generation docs say the AI edits workspace items and then hands them to the Compare & Deploy page for review. That is a first-party, prompt-driven editing capability. However, the evidence never explicitly says flows can be generated from scratch from a natural-language prompt, and 'items' is not specified as including flows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language flow generation, confirmation that flows are among the editable items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt

citations.quote: Once the AI has edited items, ask it to review the changes and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy.
